source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the R8T2 run of the port's test steps and the C3A4 unit test; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of ERH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8T2 (2026-10-18) env-reset-amp's test passes: with SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET stepped to AMP, AMP ATK about 40 and a long DEC, the attack is heard on every quick hit of the pad. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-25) ENV RESET AMP restarted LT's amp envelope from silence on every quick hit (attack about 93 ms), where OFF carried it on, measured on LT's output. Alone on ERH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) AMP restarted LT's amp envelope from silence on every quick hit (attack about 86 ms) where OFF carried it on, measured on LT's output.
scope: env-reset-amp 1.0 beside other rytm2_mods ports. SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. ERH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: ERH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: with AMP each LT hit restarts from silence (-71.4 dBFS) with an 86 ms attack; with OFF it dips only to -31.0 dBFS.
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: with AMP each LT hit restarts from silence (-72 dBFS) with a 93 ms attack; with OFF it dips only to -31 dBFS.

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Env Reset Amp's.

builds.label: R8T2
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.1, env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, lfo-rnd, comp-preview and kit-ab. env-reset-amp's OS 1.74 source is the same file as in v1.2.
results: Step 7: FUNC + MUTE > SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET steps to AMP; with AMP ATK about 40 and DEC long, the attack is heard on every quick hit.

individualTestResults: AMP ATK heard on every hit with AMP set
SXH4: AMP restarts the amp envelope on every hit; OFF carries on (measured)
SXH4: four-minute play, no freeze or dropout
Alone (ERH4): AMP restarts the amp envelope on every hit; OFF carries on (measured)

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. SXH4 links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153) that Modwerk links; C3A4's core was built before #153.
